categories.title: Booking categories
categories.description: System ones, not removable — journal shows them as a badge on the booking

link.title: Payment by link and QR
link.description: The master or admin generates a link or QR with a booking amount and shares it with the client — by chat or by showing the code at the counter. The client pays by the details in the link (card / Idram of the master, while the platform does not accept money itself) and marks it as paid.
link.example: Example: a booking for 15 000 ֏ — the client scans the QR, transfers by the shown requisites, taps "I paid", the master confirms "received" and the booking is marked paid.

widgetPrepayment.title: Prepayment in the booking widget
widgetPrepayment.description: When a client books online, the widget can require or offer a prepayment before confirming the slot. The amount is a % or a fixed sum of the service price, set per business, per service or per master. The client has a limited time to pay before the hold is released.
widgetPrepayment.example: Example: prepayment mode "required" at 30% — a 10 000 ֏ service asks for a 3 000 ֏ prepayment, the client has 15 minutes to pay or the slot frees up automatically.

onlineSales.title: Online sale of memberships and certificates
onlineSales.description: Clients buy a membership or a gift certificate online, without visiting in person, straight from the loyalty catalog. Screen and settings live in the "Loyalty" section — this card only links there.
onlineSales.example: Example: a client buys a 5-visit membership from home; it appears on their account and can be used at the next booking.
